readme:
# PigLauncher

An LSPosed module for providing modifications for POCO Launcher. Learn more about available modifications under the `Features` section.

The module only targets POCO Launcher (`com.mi.android.globallauncher`).

[![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/dinopig1219/PigLauncher?label=Release&logo=github)](https://github.com/dinopig1219/PigLauncher/releases/latest) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Repository-blue?logo=github)](https://github.com/dinopig1219/PigLauncher)

## Features

<details>
<summary>Press To Expand</summary>

- Unlock Dark Folder
  - Unlock dark appearence folder when the system is in Dark Mode. (available in HyperOS System Launcher but nuked in POCO Launcher)

- Unlock Advanced Textures
  - Unlock Advanced Textures effect to the launcher. (available in HyperOS System Launcher but nuked in POCO Launcher)

- Grid Folder Icon Fill
  - When a 2×2 or 3×3 folder contains exactly 4 or 9 apps, the last icon will display as a normal app icon size, and it is clickable to launch app.

- Fix Predictive Back Gesture Speed
  - Fixes the abnormal predictive back animation speed to restore the native speed.

- Unlock All Widgets Animation
  - Enables the back bouncing animation for all widgets.

- Hide Clear Recents Button
  - Hide the clear button in recents.

- Manage Home screen shortcuts (Hidden Apps Manager)
  - The module unlocked to let manage all app icon to show or hide.

</details>

> [!Note]
>
> 1. Initial development and testing are based on `RELEASE-6.01.05.2407-06081949`, `RELEASE-7.50.06.2592-09011644`
> 2. Tested with above versions on OS3 only. Compatibility with other POCO Launcher versions and OS versions may vary.

## How to Use

1. Install PigLauncher.
2. Enable PigLauncher in LSPosed.
3. Make sure POCO Launcher is included in the module scope.
4. Open PigLauncher and enable the features you want.
5. Restart POCO Launcher after changing module settings.
6. Enjoy!

## References

- [XiaomiHelper by HowieHChen](https://github.com/HowieHChen/XiaomiHelper): GNU General Public License v3.0

# 猪发射器

LSPoded 模块，用于为 POCO Launcher 提供修改。在“功能”部分了解有关可用修改的更多信息。

该模块仅针对 POCO Launcher (`com.mi.android.globallauncher`)。

[![最新版本](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/dinopig1219/PigLauncher?label=Release&logo=github)](https://github.com/dinopig1219/PigLauncher/releases/latest) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Repository-blue?logo=github)](https://github.com/dinopig1219/PigLauncher)

## 特点

<详情>
<summary>按展开</summary>

- 解锁黑暗文件夹
  - 当系统处于深色模式时解锁深色外观文件夹。 （在 HyperOS 系统启动器中可用，但在 POCO 启动器中可用）

- 解锁高级纹理
  - 解锁启动器的高级纹理效果。 （在 HyperOS 系统启动器中可用，但在 POCO 启动器中可用）

- 网格文件夹图标填充
  - 当 2×2 或 3×3 文件夹恰好包含 4 或 9 个应用程序时，最后一个图标将显示为正常应用程序图标大小，并且可单击以启动应用程序。

- 修复预测后退手势速度
  - 修复预测后退动画速度异常，恢复原生速度。

- 解锁所有小部件动画
  - 为所有小部件启用后退动画。

- 隐藏清除最近按钮
  - 隐藏最近通话中的清除按钮。

- 管理主屏幕快捷方式（隐藏应用程序管理器）
  - 模块已解锁，可以管理所有应用程序图标的显示或隐藏。

</详情>

> [!注意]
>
> 1.初始开发和测试基于`RELEASE-6.01.05.2407-06081949`、`RELEASE-7.50.06.2592-09011644`
> 2. 仅在 OS3 上使用以上版本进行测试。与其他 POCO Launcher 版本和操作系统版本的兼容性可能有所不同。

## 如何使用

1.安装PigLauncher。
2. 在 LSPod 中启用 PigLauncher。
3. 确保 POCO Launcher 包含在模块范围内。
4. 打开 PigLauncher 并启用您想要的功能。
5. 更改模块设置后重新启动 POCO Launcher。
6.享受吧！

## 参考文献

- [HyperCeiler by ReChronoRain](https://github.com/ReChronoRain/HyperCeiler)：GNU Affero 通用公共许可证 v3
- [miuix 由 compose-miuix-ui 提供](https://github.com/compose-miuix-ui/miuix): Apache-2.0
